description: This Java class defines an Android activity that manages immersive fullscreen mode with sticky system UI visibility flags.

classes.name: ImmersiveStickyActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that sets up immersive Sticky UI mode when window focus changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Updates system UI visibility flags to enable immersive sticky mode when the window gains focus.
